== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow was born on '''26 July 1761''' according to the inspected Findmypast OPR derivative and was baptised on '''2 August 1761''' at Currie, Midlothian.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4222434 Findmypast OPR derivative SCOT/OPR/BAP/4222434], OPR 682/2 item 2, Thomas Glasgow, birth 26 July 1761, baptism 2 August, Currie, parents John Glasgow and Mary Robertson; inspected 30 October 2026, original uninspected.</ref> The derivative names John Glasgow and Mary Robertson; identification with the selected [[Glasgow-1343|John Glasgow]] remains at 97%. The older [[Glasgow-1606]] title redirects to the same person. An older FamilySearch abstract gives a partial “Birth Date 8”; that fragment does not establish the inherited 8 September date or the former guessed July day. The explicit derivative birth day is preferred, with the older reading retained for original-register comparison.<ref>"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4X-H5X : 16 September 2021), Thomas Glasgow, christened 2 Aug 1761, Currie, Midlothian, Scotland. Parents: John Glasgow and Mary Robertson. Indexed "Birth Date 8".</ref>

On 17 May 1789, Thomas married '''Margaret Chapman''' in Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian, Scotland<ref>"Scotland Marriages, 1561-1910", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XY9W-PHS : 11 February 2020), Thomas Glasgow and Margaret Chapman, married 17 May 1789, Kirknewton and East Calder, Midlothian, Scotland.</ref>.
